title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Tinggabulong, Municipality of Dimataling, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to Be Known as Tinggabulong National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Tinggabulong, Municipality of Dimataling, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to Be Known as Tinggabulong National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Tinggabulong, Thị trấn Dimataling, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Tinggabulong
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Tinggabulong, เทศบาล Dimataling, จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Tinggabulong
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Tinggabulong, Kotamadya Dimataling, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Tinggabulong
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Tinggabulong, Perbandaran Dimataling, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Tinggabulong

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. – There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Tinggabulong, Municipality of Dimataling, Province of Zamboanga del Sur to be known as Tinggabulong National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tinggabulong National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
